reason: The pack aluminization proposal (B) more directly ensures a robust, stable Al2O3 surface scale on HfNbTaTiZr, which is a well‐demonstrated route to improving high‐temperature oxidation resistance without substantially compromising bulk mechanical properties. The yttrium alloying approach (A), while known to help oxide adhesion in Al- or Cr-containing systems, is less clearly advantageous for a non–aluminum-containing high-entropy alloy of this composition.
